verdict.rationale: Rollbar docs confirm version tracking (which code versions throw exceptions) and deploy tracking that unlocks 'features that will help your debugging process,' implying release-first-seen and regression detection, plus an AI Resolve feature that maps errors to code/PRs. However, there is no explicit documentation shown of a per-item 'first seen in release X' UI field or automated suspect-commit attribution beyond the deploy-tracking/version features. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of item pages showing 'first appeared in release' field and automatic suspect-commit linking/blame based on commit metadata.
